title: Camera experiment: can the game itself shift the camera?
intro: Reset Scripts first (TestGuide v1.4). Stand still; the camera will slide on its own for a few seconds. Note if nametags flicker during it.

steps.text: Hands off - co-op OFF. Don't touch mouse or keys.
Watch the camera: target moved 3 m on X
steps.each_frame: local mc = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController', 0); local v = mc:get_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField'); if not BO0 then BO0 = { v.x, v.y, v.z } end; v.x, v.y, v.z = BO0[1] + 3.0, BO0[2], BO0[3] + 0.0; mc:set_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField', v)

steps.text: Watch: target moved 3 m on Z
steps.each_frame: local mc = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController', 0); local v = mc:get_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField'); if not BO0 then BO0 = { v.x, v.y, v.z } end; v.x, v.y, v.z = BO0[1] + 0.0, BO0[2], BO0[3] + 3.0; mc:set_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField', v)

local mc = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController', 0); local v = mc:get_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField'); if not BO0 then BO0 = { v.x, v.y, v.z } end; v.x, v.y, v.z = BO0[1] + 0.0, BO0[2], BO0[3] + 0.0; mc:set_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField', v)

probes.rel: local c=sdk.get_primary_camera():call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local a=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); return string.format('%.2f,%.2f,%.2f', c.x-a.x, c.y-a.y, c.z-a.z)
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.bo: local v=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController', 0):get_field('<BaseOffset>k__BackingField'); return string.format('%.2f,%.2f,%.2f', v.x, v.y, v.z)
